## Decision

The bin/ledger deprecation notice writes to stderr only and leaves the exit code and stdout untouched. bin/ledger and hooks/ledger.mjs both remain on disk and remain functional.

## Rationale

bin/ledger stdout is parsed by agents and its exit code is read by guards including piped-exit-code-guard. A notice on stdout or a changed exit code would be a behavior change and would violate D6. Supersedes the mis-numbered append made earlier this session (2026-09-01T06:29Z) which collided with an existing decision id; that event is void.

## Alternatives Considered

- Print on stdout as a leading comment line
- Exit non-zero to force migration
